chapter: Rene, Whitney Bank and early life
title: Serenading string bands and Galloway's repertoire
summary: Boys' string bands serenaded at night; Galloway played ragtime and waltzes.

blocks.x: on it you know and make and pull it. When you were a little kid say five or six years old do you remember any groups like that that the boys, children, every

boys ever get together and play that? Well about that time they used to go around and serenade you know and string band. Used real instruments. Yeah they used to use a guitar and some used a mandolin guitar and a bass some used violin. Oh they always used violin. And they'd go around at night, late at night when people be sleeping at twelve o'clock at night and they start up a tune that you do and people get up you know. They'd go away then the surprise. That's what it was.
I was going to ask some more about those old times like the Galloway band. What kind of music did they play? Was it the real good ragtime? Yes it was ragtime band. Was it the classical waltzes and
waltzes or things? They used to play plenty of waltzes too that time.
